Professional Football Club Ludogorets 1945, commonly known as Ludogorets Razgrad, Ludogorets 1945 or simply Ludogorets, is a Bulgarian professional association football club based in Razgrad, which currently competes in the First Professional Football League, the top tier of the Bulgarian football league system.
